skills.name: research
skills.description: Search the web, fetch Markdown, and recall or cache research Assets.
skills.instructions: Candidates carry an Asset URL and a turn ref. Open full Markdown and result records with view_asset. Edit their writable Assets with edit_asset, then cache or submit the refs you want to keep. Cached material may be stale.

tools.name: real_search
tools.description: Search the real web. Limit applies to this upstream request only. Results include an Asset URL and turn ref.

tools.name: real_fetch
tools.description: Fetch Markdown as a writable Asset. Use backend=local for truncated API content.

tools.name: virtual_search
tools.description: Recall cached page and result Assets by literal query or exact source URL. Omit both to list recent items.

tools.name: cache_search_results
tools.description: Cache the selected or supplied result refs and their Asset revisions for a query.

tools.name: cache_page
tools.description: Cache the current Asset revision of a page ref.

skills.name: view_asset
skills.description: View Asset URLs supplied with messages or returned by tools.
skills.instructions: Use the Asset URL as-is. Search text with grep and original bytes with raw_grep. Use pattern ^ with a small limit to read consecutive lines or hex rows. Continue at next_line or next_offset. If the media type is unclear, inspect the URL metadata first. You can also pass the URL directly to a tool that accepts an Asset URL. Samples returned by viewers have their own Asset URLs.

tools.name: view_image
tools.description: View an image, with a longest side up to 4096 pixels. Crop a viewport using original image pixels.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

viewport.description: Crop x, y, width, height from the source before resizing. Origin is top left.

tools.name: view_video_frame
tools.description: View a video frame at start_ms, with a longest side up to 4096 pixels. Crop using pixels of the displayed frame.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

viewport.description: Crop x, y, width, height from the source before resizing. Origin is top left.

tools.name: view_video
tools.description: Send the complete video to a video-capable model.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: view_video_audio_clip
tools.description: Listen to up to 30 seconds from the video's audio track.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: view_audio
tools.description: Send the complete audio file to an audio-capable model.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search UTF text or extracted attachment text by ripgrep-style regex or literal string. Returns matching line numbers, columns, and previews with optional surrounding lines. Use ^ to read lines and next_line to resume.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: raw_grep
tools.description: Search original bytes. Regex matches 32-byte hex rows with byte spaces and a | between groups of eight. Use literal with bytes like 50 4B 03 04 for exact sequences across rows. Returns zero-based byte offsets and hex rows. Use next_offset to resume.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: view_pdf_page
tools.description: Render a PDF page or part of it, with a longest side up to 4096 pixels. Page numbers start at 1. Viewport coordinates are in PDF points.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

viewport.description: Crop x, y, width, height from the source before resizing. Origin is top left.

tools.name: view_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Inspect the PDF document and its page count.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: view_image_metadata
tools.description: Inspect image dimensions and available format metadata.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: view_video_metadata
tools.description: Inspect video dimensions, duration, and audio-track presence.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

tools.name: view_url_metadata
tools.description: Inspect an authorised Asset URL, MIME type, origin, and known size.

url.description: An Asset URL from this session.

skills.name: edit_asset
skills.description: Apply exact text replacements or byte patches to writable Asset URLs supplied to this session.
skills.instructions: Inspect the current Asset with view_asset before editing. Use exact matching text for text_edit and verify old bytes with raw_grep before bin_patch. Keep unrelated content intact.

tools.name: bin_patch
tools.description: Replace expected old_hex at a zero-based byte offset. Use space-separated bytes with optional | separators. An empty old_hex inserts, and an empty new_hex deletes.

tools.name: text_edit
tools.description: Replace an exact, unique old_string with new_string. Set replace_all to replace every occurrence. For UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16 Assets.

skills.name: plugin-docs
skills.description: Read or search the built-in plugin development guide, API reference and manifest schema.
skills.instructions: Search the exact heading or field in the narrowest topic. Query ## Assets in assets for package resources, or 声明状态和卡片 in automation for the card and state manifest example. Use schema for field types. To continue a result, pass next_offset as offset with the same topic and omit query.

tools.name: plugin_docs
tools.description: Read a focused topic. Use assets for declared resources and Actions, automation for state and card previews, and development for drafts and publishing.

skills.name: preset-docs
skills.description: Look up preset modes, delegated search and ensemble rooms.

tools.name: preset_docs
tools.description: Read or search the preset guide.

skills.name: plugin-development
skills.description: Delegate and track plugin projects in the current preset.
skills.instructions: Delegate each project to its own PluginAgent. Describe the user entry point, the expected result, important constraints, and any deployment authorization. Pass exact Asset URLs for reference material. Use the existing agent ID for revisions and fixes. Use plugin_wait when you need a result now. Later results arrive in the preset session, including after this turn. Archive inactive agents. Review the report and verify any available installed entry point. Assign all implementation, draft tests, fixes, and deployment to PluginAgent.

tools.name: plugin_spawn
tools.description: Start an independent PluginAgent and return its persistent ID immediately.

tools.name: plugin_list
tools.description: List the current preset's PluginAgents with statuses and latest results.

tools.name: plugin_send
tools.description: Send a follow-up to an existing agent. Steers an active run at the next safe boundary.

tools.name: plugin_wait
tools.description: Wait for one or several agents and return their current statuses and finished results. Late results and errors are delivered as system messages.

tools.name: plugin_archive
tools.description: Stop and archive an agent while retaining its project and conversation.

tools.name: plugin_resume
tools.description: Restore an archived PluginAgent so you can send another task.

skills.name: plugin-project
skills.description: Debug, publish and remove the PluginAgent's assigned plugin draft.
skills.instructions: Call project_debug with the declared Action URL and a fixture event. Inspect the first result before adding an assertion. For Android cards, use project_card_catalog for unfamiliar components, then project_card_preview to check rendered text, diagnostics and relevant controls. Preview can seed state with an Action and provides virtual chat and room IDs. After changes, rerun the affected fixture. When authorized to publish, pass handler, event and expected_result_json to project_publish. Encode the inner result as JSON text, for example {"count":2}. Check verification.ok for the installed generation. project_verify repeats that isolated check. For a real public text Asset, use view_asset and plugin_base_grep on the installed minirp://assets/ URL. Use the appropriate chat, settings or attachment entry for other live tests. Removal keeps the draft.

tools.name: project_debug
tools.description: Validate the signed draft. Optionally call a declared Action URL in this draft's isolated environment with a fixture event.

expected_result_json.description: Optional JSON text for the exact handler result. Copy only the inner result. Omit on the first test.

expected_result.description: Optional direct JSON value for existing callers. Supply only one expected result field.

tools.name: project_card_catalog
tools.description: Read the Android OpenUI component and syntax reference generated by the same library that renders plugin cards. Query a component name or page using next_offset.

tools.name: project_card_preview
tools.description: Render this draft's declared card in the Android OpenUI renderer. Optionally run an Action hook with a fixture event first to seed the isolated state. Use up to six steps, each naming a visible control and an optional value for an input. Linking or replying captures a payload. Each call starts with fresh state.

screenshot.description: Attach a PNG of the final rendered card to your next model request. Request this if your model accepts image input.

viewport.description: Crop x, y, width, height from the source before resizing. Origin is top left.

control.description: The exact label returned by the preview.

value.description: Set a value on a native input. Pass numbers as strings. Omit to click.

tools.name: project_publish
tools.description: Test and install the signed draft, then check the installed generation in isolation. A new deployment is scoped to this preset.

handler.description: A declared Action URL to test before and after install. Omit for a load check.

expected_result_json.description: JSON text for the exact handler result. Copy only the inner result of a successful draft test. A mismatch blocks deployment.

expected_result.description: Optional direct JSON value for existing callers. Supply only one expected result field.

tools.name: project_verify
tools.description: Retest this project's installed generation in isolation, with a fixture or a load check. Leaves the live plugin and its data alone.

expected_result_json.description: Optional JSON text for the exact handler result. Copy only the inner result.

expected_result.description: Optional direct JSON value for existing callers. Supply only one expected result field.

tools.name: project_remove
tools.description: Uninstall this project's deployment and retain its editable source.
